description: Reproducible CPU-only Snakemake workflow to deduplicate pre-existing COCO object detections across aligned aerial/UAV frames. Floating-point bounding-box intersections identify candidate matches and NetworkX connected components resolve transitive duplicates without additional object-detector or GPU inference. Includes a five-detection, three-unique-object synthetic demonstration and optional OpenCV UAV-frame alignment. Real-world accuracy is not assessed by this example.
name: CPU-Only Spatial Object Deduplication for UAV Aerial Imagery
